Search for the medicine known as "Thorn Devourer Salve."

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Officer Chitaro]].
* Speak to [[Guardsman Pah]].
* Talk to [[Budo]].
* See Paomu for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest takes place entirely in [[Wajjun Bazaar]] and requires little (if any) fighting. Due to the sequence of events, it does require a significant amount of "backtracking" to complete, since [[Guardsman Pah]] is located between [[Paomu]] and [[Officer Chitaro]], and [[Budo]] is located beyond both of them (along the path to [[The Marketplace]]). Once you have spoken to [[Paomu]], [[Officer Chitaro]] and [[Guardsman Pah]] (in that order), you can map travel to [[The Marketplace]] to meet [[Budo]], before returning to [[Paomu]] for the reward. If you have access to [[Nahpui Quarter]] then map traveling there after meeting [[Budo]] shortens the amount of time to complete this quest.

==NPCs==
===Alies===
*{{x}} 10 [[Budo]]
*{{x}} 20 [[Guardsman Pah]]
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Officer Chitaro]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
Paomu
:''"<Character name>! Please, you must help me! My son has fallen ill with a terrible malady, and the healers claim that the only cure is a rare medicine known as '''Thorn Devourer Salve'''. The Celestial Ministry has a huge supply of medicines from all over the world, but due to some silly regulations they won't allow me to purchase it. Will you help me get some?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll see what I can do.
|decline = You want me to convince a hopelessly bureaucratic organization to change its rules for you? Take a number, lady.
|ask = Have you found any '''Thorn Devourer Salve'''? My son's condition grows worse by the day! 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Officer Chitaro
:''"Why do people continually bother me about medicines and cures? Speak to Guardsman Pah; he is responsible for our medicinal stores. If he has the medicine you seek, you may petition the case after all the appropriate scrollwork is filled out in triplicate."''

;Guardsman Pah
:''"Chitaro sent you, eh? For Thorn Devourer Salve? I would love to help, but I have none. The last remaining bottle was sold to a wealthy nobleman named Budo a few days ago, and the ministry has refused to order additional quantities. Something to do with a forced shortage intended to drive up the price. Perhaps Budo still has some left he would be willing to sell?"''

;Budo
:''"Thorn Devourer Salve? I had some, but it did not work the way I had hoped. You see, I...I mean, my wife and I, have been experiencing some...personal difficulties. A friend of mine swore that Thorn Devourer Salve could help my...inability. Needless to say, it did not work. Otherwise, why would I be standing here talking to the likes of you? On the bright side, I have not felt this energized in years! I am afraid I do not have any left."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Paomu
:''"A shortage? I see. Thank you for your help, <Character name>. Perhaps I can find a ship to Kryta so I can acquire the salve myself."''

==Note==
*This quest can be done without any fighting.
